Author: bodyboarder2528
Description: Device support for the AJAZZ AKP153E (rev. 2) using only signed code (Node + PowerShell + Windows' hid.dll), because Smart App Control blocks the original opendeck-akp153 plugin's exe. Adds animated GIF keys, a whole-deck screensaver, homelab alert flashes, night dimming, a system monitor key, an audio output switcher, and the fix for the sustained-animation lock-up (key images capped at 3 KB, as the official app does).
Name: Jarvis AKP153E

Actions.Name: Animated GIF
Actions.Tooltip: Plays a GIF on this key (AKP153E only). Set the file in the settings.

Actions.Name: System monitor
Actions.Tooltip: Live CPU %, RAM % and GPU temperature.

Actions.Name: Audio output
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the current playback device. Press to switch to the next one (set which ones in jarvis-akp153.json, audio.cycle).
